_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF (joint): Sir Thomas Urquhart (1611-1660) and Peter Anthony Motteux (1663-1718). Rabelais, Gargantua and Pantagruel (Urquhart Books I-III 1653/1693, Motteux IV-V 1694), and Motteux's Don Quixote (1700-03, revised by Ozell). PD. Added 2026-10-02 by lane C after the coordinator's 'keep going, more translator shelves' relay; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

motteux-quixote: Cervantes, The History of Don Quixote, tr. Motteux

urquhart-motteux-rabelais.note: Two hands: Urquhart I-III, Motteux IV-V; one title because that is how the book has been printed since 1708.
urquhart-motteux-rabelais.held_note: adler_shelf.json credits 'tr. Urquhart' only; PG 1200 is Urquhart (I-III) and Motteux (IV-V).
urquhart-motteux-rabelais.translator: Thomas Urquhart (Books I-III), Peter Anthony Motteux (IV-V)

_excluded.pg-8166..8170: Doré-illustrated Rabelais, same text in parts.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
